notes: The Item 7 (targeted) section provided was empty, so no MD&A excerpts were available. The Human Capital section is well over 150 words, so Community and Cross-cultural coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. Traps excluded: 'Storylines' and 'contextual narratives' are technical terms for behavioral data, not storytelling; 'design' refers to engineering; 'educating the public about cyber threats' is marketing content; 'Singularity Marketplace' is a third-party integration ecosystem, not a seller marketplace for small businesses; channel partners (MSPs, MSSPs) are distribution partnerships; 'state-of-the-art', 'innovative' and 'Ingenuity' are excluded; 'Community' and 'inclusive culture' appear only as core-value statements. International offices and the Amsterdam headquarters choice ('language versatility, diversity') and revenue outside the U.S. (39%) do not count for Cross-cultural. Gender-neutral parental leave (E2) is a borderline inclusive benefit; it was scored at level 1 under the 'when torn, pick the lower level' rule. E2's quote is a single full sentence of about 55 words, kept whole so it is a complete thought. Workplace awards are recognition, not activities.
